# MCP Status

> MCP Status (https://mcp-status-directory.netlify.app) is a health-ranked directory of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. Every listing carries a dated, evidence-based health score (0-100) from public signals: GitHub repo exists, archived flag, last push recency, whether the npm/PyPI package resolves, and stars. Archived and stale servers are flagged explicitly.

Last full check: 2026-11-09T09:06:12Z. 133 servers: 102 Healthy, 26 Stale, 5 Archived.

## Key pages
- [Ranked list of all servers](https://mcp-status-directory.netlify.app/)
- [Status / archived & stale flags](https://mcp-status-directory.netlify.app/status.html)
- [Methodology](https://mcp-status-directory.netlify.app/methodology.html)
- [Raw data JSON](https://mcp-status-directory.netlify.app/data/servers.json)
